subject: Affinity AI — hosted API token runway & peak TPS recap
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@affinity.ai>, Jorge Alvarez <jorge@affinity.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Dec 2028 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Affinity AI — hosted API token runway & peak TPS recap

Hi Samira / Jorge — thanks again for the demo today. Quick post-call recap and a couple of asks so we can size a hosted API pricing proposal that maps to your budget and peak needs.

What we heard (please correct if I missed anything):
- Primary product: customer support summarization + conversational assistant for enterprise customers (integrated into your dashboard).
- Expected pilot/T1: ~Q1 2029, pilot window 6–8 weeks; production thereafter.
- Rough usage signal: many short requests (500–1,200 tokens/request) plus some longer transcript summarization jobs.
- Key constraints: want hosted API to avoid infra ops; prefer US residency for customer data.

Asks / what we need to finalize pricing:
1) Confirm expected monthly token volume (ballpark is fine) and the worst-case 15-minute peak TPS you need us to support.
2) Target $/1M tokens or budget range for hosted API during pilot and for ramp (helpful to give both pilot and steady-state targets).
3) Any constraints on latency (p50/p95 goals) and whether streaming responses are required.

I've attached the traffic template you mentioned — can you drop your numbers into affinity_traffic_estimate.csv and re-send? That will let Karthik run a quick unit-econ simulation and give an apples-to-apples hosted price.

Next steps from our side:
- Karthik will surface a 2-option pricing sketch (conservative / optimized) once we have the traffic numbers.
- Marissa will outline a short pilot commercial (3-month commitment) if the numbers line up.
- We'll include a note on data residency and SLA options for the pilot.

Would love the traffic file back by EOD Monday so we can get a draft to you mid-week.

Thanks — 

Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | (415) 555-0172
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 07 Dec 2028 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Affinity AI — hosted API token runway & peak TPS recap

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the clear notes. Attached is our traffic breakdown (see file). Quick answers inline: 

- Monthly token volume (pilot): ~180,000,000 tokens/month. Expect ~500–700k requests/day during pilot, ramping to ~3–4M requests/day in steady state over 6 months.
- Peak TPS: we've modeled a 15-minute burst up to ~240 TPS (most of the traffic sits around 30–60 TPS outside of promotional events).
- Budget target: for pilot we were hoping to keep unit economics under $900 / 1M tokens; steady-state target is $750 / 1M if we can get a committed tier.
- Latency: p95 should be under 800ms for the assistant API; streaming for long summaries is preferred but not mandatory for MVP.
- Data residency: US only for now.

I'll attach the CSV (traffic_estimate.csv) — it has per-endpoint token averages and hourly shape. Let us know if you need more granularity.

Samira Khan
Head of Product
Affinity AI
samira@affinity.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@affinity.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 08 Dec 2028 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Affinity AI — hosted API token runway & peak TPS recap

Hi Samira — thanks for the file, that helps a lot. I ran a quick pass on the traffic_estimate.csv and sketched out unit-econ ranges that map to your targets. High level:

- Pilot volume (180M tokens/mo) + 15-min peak of 240 TPS is an achievable hosted configuration.
- Cost levers we recommend to hit ~$750–900 / 1M tokens: quantized model variants (8-bit), prefix/KV caching for user sessions, and 50–80ms batching windows for non-latency-sensitive endpoints.

Preliminary unit-econ guidance (ballpark per 1M tokens):
- Optimized path (quantized + cache + batching): ~$680–760 / 1M tokens
- Balanced (quantized + cache): ~$760–880 / 1M tokens
- Conservative (fp16, minimal caching): ~$1,050+ / 1M tokens

Given your $900 pilot target, the balanced option maps cleanly. If you sign up for a committed tier (3-month minimum at 150M/mo commit) we can bring the pilot price to ~$800 / 1M and then tier down to ~$720 / 1M at steady state as you hit >250M/mo.

Operational notes for peak 240 TPS:
- We'll provision Dedicated-backed capacity pools for the peak window and configure smart routing to fall back to a slightly cheaper model variant if capacity is constrained.
- For the 15-minute burst, autoscaling + short-term burst capacity is recommended; we'll model cost impact separately.

Open questions that affect final price:
1) Average prompt + completion length per endpoint (I used the CSV averages, but sanity-check please).
2) Percent of requests that will use streaming (streaming adds slight infra overhead; affects unit cost).
3) Any regulatory/compliance add-ons (SOC2/enterprise logging) you need for the pilot — these are billable add-ons.

I uploaded a short PDF with the unit-econ math and assumptions: redwood_unit_econ_v1.pdf. Also linking the HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/aff-2028-0719.

If it helps, happy to hop on a 30-min calibration call next week to lock down prompt lengths and batching windows — those parameters materially change the per-1M estimate.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Hi Samira / Jorge — appreciate the quick turn on the traffic file and Karthik's analysis. From a commercial perspective we can do the following to get you into a hosted pilot quickly: 

Pilot offer (3-month):
- Commitment: 150M tokens / month minimum for 3 months
- Pilot price: $800 / 1M tokens (applies to usage up to 250M / month; overage at $740 / 1M)
- Peak capacity: guaranteed support up to 240 TPS during the 15-minute burst window; data residency US.
- Add-ons: SOC2 evidence + audit logs available as an add-on (approx +$1,500/mo).

If that framework looks reasonable I can get a short SOW and pilot schedule drafted this week and route it to procurement/legal. Our standard next step is a 15-min commercial sync to confirm billing contact and billing address. 

Would you be open to a 15-min call on Wednesday? Stephanie — can you propose times; Karthik and I will join to finalize the pilot terms.

Best,
Marissa Cole
